The **Atrieflimren-klinik** (Atrial Fibrillation Clinic) is an interdisciplinary medical clinic hosted by [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]] in Denmark [^src1]. Established in 2012, the clinic serves as a central example of quality improvement implementation and functions as a concrete model for structured patient education within the national framework for atrial fibrillation treatment [^src1]. 

Since its inception, the clinic has maintained a continuous focus on educating patients and their relatives [^src1]. The clinic is led by [[dorthe-svenstrup|Dorthe Svenstrup]] [^src1]. A key component of their educational practice is the use of the [[ambuflex-skema|Ambuflex-skema]], a questionnaire that patients complete at home prior to their consultations, which forms the foundation of the patient education process [^src1]. 

Within the broader context of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) quality development framework, the Atrieflimren-klinik illustrates how clinical practices can be structured to ensure uniform, evidence-based, and patient-centered care for a common and potentially serious chronic heart condition [^src1].
